Hydrocodone tartrate may be given as part of a combination preparation for the relief of irritant cough in children aged from 6 to 12 years in usual oral doses of 2.5 mg every 4 to 6 hours. Older children may be given the usual adult dose (see above). Pharmacokinetics. References. 1. Hutchinson MR, et al.
